text: 温室里的花朵——经不起风雨
pinyin: wēn shì lǐ de huā duǒ —— jīng bù qǐ fēng yǔ
literal: greenhouse · inside · 's · flower — endure · not · wind · rain
natural: Greenhouse flowers cannot stand wind and rain

meaning.en: Sheltered people who can't cope with hardship.
meaning.zh: 在温室中长大的花经不起风雨，比喻缺乏磨炼、承受不了挫折的人。

examples.zh: 现在的孩子是温室里的花朵，经不起风雨。
examples.en: Today's children are hothouse flowers who can't handle hardship.

examples.zh: 别把孩子当温室里的花朵，要让他锻炼。
examples.en: Don't treat the child as a hothouse flower; let him toughen up.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Commonly said of the young; often just 温室里的花朵.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。多指年轻人，常只说前半句。

text: 孙大圣管蟠桃园——监守自盗
pinyin: sūn dà shèng guǎn pán táo yuán —— jiān shǒu zì dào
literal: Monkey King · look after · Peach Garden — supervise · guard · oneself · steal
natural: The Monkey King guarding the Peach Garden

meaning.en: The guardian steals from what he guards.
meaning.zh: 孙悟空管蟠桃园时偷吃仙桃，比喻管理者自己侵吞财物。

examples.zh: 孙大圣管蟠桃园，会计挪用公款，真是监守自盗。
examples.en: The accountant embezzled the funds in his charge.

examples.zh: 孙大圣管蟠桃园，仓库管理员监守自盗被警方抓获。
examples.en: The warehouse keeper stole the goods he guarded and was caught.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. From 《西游记》; the punchline is the chengyu 监守自盗.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。出自《西游记》；后半句即成语“监守自盗”。
